findings_addressed: F-AC1-NONNUMERIC-ONCHAIN-COERCION: In validate_onchain_feature_ranges, fit_fuzzy_feature_scaling, and apply_fuzzy_feature_scaling, conversion failures are detected by checking for (orig.notna() & converted.isna()) and raised as ValueError('...contains non-numeric values...'), while true NaNs remain allowed for warmup. Added tests for malformed text at validator, apply, and fit levels in tests/unit/test_fuzzy_scaling.py.

F-AC1-SCALE-MANIFEST-BYPASS: In fit_fuzzy_feature_scaling, validated bounded on-chain inputs (rejecting non-numeric, infinite, all-non-finite, and out-of-range values) before returning the FEATURE_SCALE_MANIFEST override. Added test_fit_fuzzy_feature_scaling_validates_manifest_override_path in tests/unit/test_fuzzy_scaling.py.

F-AC3-RB-OUTPUT-DIGEST-MISSING: Stamped feature_contract_digest at rb_governor._strategy output (top-level and in strategy_contract), preserved it in _validate_rule_set in output/writer.py, and verified Phase 5 load_strategies() accepts freshly generated strategies end-to-end including generated_lwc mode. Added tests in tests/unit/test_output_writer.py and tests/unit/test_phase5_oos.py.

F-AC3-MTF-LWC-NOT-REBUILT: In run_pipeline.py, added LWC discovery/rebuild via run_phase2 when lwc_rules is None and archive is missing or stale (matching HWC and MWC handling), and ensured run_phase catches stale LWC archives and triggers rebuild during MTF composition. Added composition rebuild tests for LWC, HWC, and MWC in tests/unit/test_mtf_pipeline_integration.py.

F-AC3-MTF-LIST-DIGEST-BYPASS: In mtf/archives.py load_mtf_archive_payload and load_mtf_rule_archive, reject list payloads failing closed with ValueError, and enforce feature_contract_digest check on dict payloads. Added tests for list archive rejection and missing-digest rejection in tests/unit/test_mtf_pipeline_integration.py.

F-TEST-MISSING-INVALIDATION-PATHS: Added missing-digest and invalidation tests across MTF (missing digest, legacy list, LWC/HWC/MWC rebuild), Phase 2 (missing digest), RB output (missing digest rejection, end-to-end acceptance, generated_lwc mode), and output writer (digest preservation).
